summary.text: Jeff Golden is a Democratic member of the Oregon State Senate for District 3, which his legislative page associates with Ashland, and was elected in November 2018.
His biography describes a career in politics, broadcasting and journalism, and he is the author of the book Watermelon Summer.

paragraphs.text: Golden attended Harvard University as a National Scholar and then moved to the backwoods of Oregon, a journey he chronicled in Watermelon Summer (1971).
After about a decade building homes, guiding whitewater river trips and working in the Cascade forests, he earned a master's degree in communications from Stanford University.
His biography says his political career included service as a Jackson County commissioner, chief of staff to the Oregon Senate president and environmental policy aide to the City of Portland.
He hosted the daily public radio talk show The Jefferson Exchange and created the public television series Immense Possibilities, and he also wrote the novels Forest Blood and Unafraid.
Golden lives in Ashland with his wife, Sarah Collard.
